name: AMOS22
description: AMOS22 is an abdominal multi-organ segmentation challenge and benchmark featuring 500 CT and 100 MRI scans with voxel-level annotations for 15 abdominal organs, designed to evaluate segmentation across diverse clinical imaging settings.
citation: Ji et al., AMOS: A Large-Scale Abdominal Multi-Organ Benchmark for Versatile Medical Image Segmentation, arXiv:2206.08023, 2022.

license.notes: Challenge data access and use are subject to the upstream terms; clinical scans are not vendored.
